cyclic_shape.valid_cycle_close: heel_strike with cycle_valid == 1, paired to the preceding accepted heel_strike and an intervening accepted toe_off
cyclic_shape.cycle_interval: physical event_time_s boundaries; samples within [HS_start,HS_end), with piecewise-linear boundary values included
cyclic_shape.aggregation_rule: At least two distinct complete valid cycles EACH pass BOTH joint thresholds. Every cycle is measured and reported. Do not use the full-horizon excursion, max excursion across cycles, or a knee maximum from one cycle and ankle maximum from another. Additional valid cycles may be nonqualifying; invalid/rejected/degraded cycles already fail the zero-event gates.

technical_classification.SegmentWallClockTimeout: TECHNICAL_CENSORED regardless of the harness physical_guard_censored label
technical_classification.other_numerical_exception: TECHNICAL_CENSORED unless a separately recorded physical guard already failed
technical_classification.missing_or_inconsistent_measurement_for_: POSTPROCESSING_UNRESOLVED, not an invented physical failure
technical_classification.render_error_with_verifiable_numeric_dat: classification preserved; render issue recorded separately
technical_classification.unreturned_transition: Do not invent reward/events/end state for it

statistics.primary_denominator: all selected random poses, controls excluded
statistics.success_ci: exact binomial Clopper-Pearson two-sided95% and one-sided95% lower bound, conditional on geometric eligibility and fixed experimental stack
statistics.unresolved_cases: Report pessimistic/optimistic success proportion bounds on selected N; no single unconditional CP claim with unresolved technical cases
